algorithm.step: Split on slash or backslash, omitting empty path components
Find last component equal to Codex. Require immediately preceding Documents, with case-sensitive Swift String equality
Require exactly one or two remaining path components
For one remaining component, split hyphen preserving empty pieces, require at least four pieces, use first three as date and join remaining pieces by hyphen as slug
For two remaining components, first is hyphen-split date preserving empties with exactly three pieces, second is slug
Date parts have Swift Character counts 4,2,2 and every Character.isNumber. No month/day range validation
Slug consists of nonempty hyphen-separated parts, each exclusively ASCII lowercase a-z or digits 0-9

forms: <arbitrary-prefix>/Documents/Codex/<4 numeric Characters>-<2 numeric Characters>-<2 numeric Characters>-<slug>
<arbitrary-prefix>/Documents/Codex/<4 numeric Characters>-<2 numeric Characters>-<2 numeric Characters>/<slug>
limits: No calendar, filesystem existence, symlink or dot-path normalization is performed by the inspected predicate
Unicode numeric and whitespace properties in replay follow the local Swift/Foundation toolchain
This predicate alone does not prove host arbitration, grouping-mode raw tags, pinned overrides, section merge or official UI behavior
